title: No (Verity)
blurb: Verity's 'No' — the flat refusal from the yellow companion who became Minecraft horror's breakout star. What makes it unsettling is the total lack of emotion: Verity isn't angry, isn't negotiating, just declining. ThatMob's series made this little voice genuinely ominous, and the internet adopted it as the coldest possible rejection sound.
origin: From ThatMob's Verity Minecraft horror series.
